subject: BrightCloud onboarding: cost & performance tuning kickoff
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@brightcloud.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: BrightCloud onboarding: cost & performance tuning kickoff

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering and infra teams reviewed Redwood's runtime capabilities and we want to move forward with a short onboarding focused on cost/performance tuning before full rollout. High-level asks: batching/caching recommendations for our request profile, a quantization profile suggestion (we run mixed precision on A100s but may move to T4 in dev), and routing policy guidance to hit 95th percentile latency targets.

Can we kick off a 60-minute technical handoff next week to align owners, timelines, and deliverables? Proposed attendees from our side: me (product), Ravi Kumar (infra), and procurement (to discuss contract timing).

I've attached a short sample prompt set and our throughput requirements.

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Head of AI Integrations
BrightCloud

Attachments: brightcloud_sample_prompts.txt (text), requirements_summary.pdf (referenced)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@brightcloud.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T13:04:00Z
Subject: Re: BrightCloud onboarding: cost & performance tuning kickoff

Anna — great to hear and excited to help get this into production. 60 minutes is perfect. Proposed agenda:

- 0-10m: Introductions & success criteria (latency SLOs, cost targets, data residency)
- 10-25m: Workload walk-through (Marissa will lead on request/seq len distributions)
- 25-40m: Quick run-through of batching/caching patterns and KV/prefix caching we recommend
- 40-50m: Quantization matrix options and trade-offs (Rishi to present)
- 50-60m: Routing policies / canary fallback plan + next steps and owners

Tentative owners:
- Marissa Cole: batching & caching tests, prefix/KV cache tuning
- Rishi Malhotra: quantization profile recommendations and small-variance QA plan
- Monica Patel: routing policies, canary rollout, and SLA checklist

Can you confirm Ravi and procurement availability for next Tue/Wed (Nov 18/19) 10-11am PT? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm. I've attached an initial Redwood econ checklist and quant-profile primer to speed the conversation.

Logan
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_econ_checklist.xlsx, quant-profile-matrix.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T13:07:00Z
Subject: Fwd: BrightCloud onboarding: cost & performance tuning kickoff

Team — forwarding BrightCloud's note and the plan I sent. Quick assignments and immediate asks before the kickoff: 

1) Marissa: please prepare a short test plan (1 page) that covers: microbenchmarks for batching (batch sizes 1/4/16/64), prefix/KV cache hit simulations, and a list of 5 representative prompt templates from BrightCloud_sample_prompts.txt. Include estimated token-cost delta for each test.

2) Rishi: prepare the quantization matrix for the 7B/13B family we discussed — include expected latency/speedups on A100 and T4 and recommended fallback model variants (e.g., fp16 -> int8/4-bit suggestions). Note any potential regressions on output quality and suggested eval prompts.

3) Monica: draft a routing policy playbook (1 page) that spells out primary/secondary model routing, region-aware fallback, and a canary window (metric thresholds for rollback).

Due: draft versions by EOD Monday (Nov 17). We'll sync Tues morning to finalize slides for the customer kickoff. Keep it pragmatic — BrightCloud needs specific checkboxes they can run.

Logan

--- Forwarded message attached above ---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-16T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightCloud onboarding: cost & performance tuning kickoff

Thanks Logan — I can own the batching/caching side. Quick notes from my draft test plan (attached as "redwood_econ_checklist.xlsx"):

- Setup: synthetic load generator that mirrors BrightCloud's sample_prompts distribution (short/med/long).
- Microbenchmarks: batch sizes 1/4/16/64. Record p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput, token-cost per request.
- Cache experiments: prefix cache warm vs cold (simulate user session reuse), KV cache effectiveness for chatting flows. Measure hit-rate vs cost savings.
- Deliverables: CSV with latency/cost breakdown, short recommendations doc (3 lines per recommendation), a runbook snippet they can paste into their infra.

I'll include a short token-estimate table in the spreadsheet and flag which tests need a dedicated instance vs can run on shared dev. Draft to you by Nov 17 17:00 PT.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Logan / Marissa — thank you both. Nov 18 at 10am PT works for Ravi and me. Procurement flagged that contract signature should land by Nov 30 to hit our Q1 milestone; they may ask for a shortened SLA review during the kickoff. Ravi will join and likely share access to an internal sandbox for the microbenchmarks.

Please make sure the econ checklist includes estimated hours and any assumptions about data sharing or VPN access. Procurement is cc'd for any billing/PO questions. Looking forward to the call — we'll have Ravi join from infra and he might ask for the quant-profile matrix in advance.

Best,
Anna
